meta.name: setup-cms
meta.description: Connect a CMS to notfair SEO tools. Guides users through configuring WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost — tests the connection, and writes credentials to .env.local. Once set up, seo-analysis automatically cross- references CMS content against Google Search Console data. Use whenever the user says "connect my CMS", "set up WordPress", "configure Strapi", "add Contentful", "connect Ghost", or "CMS setup". Also trigger if the user asks why no CMS data appears in a seo-analysis report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接你的 CMS 到 SEO 工具，自动同步内容数据
copy.tagline_en: Connect your CMS to SEO tools and sync content data automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, or Ghost and need SEO analysis

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会带你连接 CMS（支持 WordPress、Strapi、Contentful 等），收集网址和密钥，写入 .env.local，测试连接；之后 seo-analysis 会把 CMS 内容与 Google Search Console 数据对照，找出无展示页面等。
howto.when: 当你说“connect my CMS”“set up WordPress”等关键词，或要求配置某个 CMS（如 Strapi 等）时触发；问为何 seo-analysis 报告没有 CMS 数据也会触发。

say.text: 连接我的 WordPress 网站
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写网址、用户名和应用密码。

say.text: 为什么 seo-analysis 报告里没有 CMS 数据？
say.note: 会开始执行 CMS 连接流程。

howto.what_en: Claude guides CMS setup (e.g., WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, etc.): collects credentials, writes .env.local, tests connection. After setup, seo-analysis cross-references CMS content with Google Search Console data for gaps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "connect my CMS", "set up WordPress", or ask to configure a CMS (e.g., Strapi, etc.), or when you ask why no CMS data appears in a seo-analysis report.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for the URL, username, and app password.
It will ask for your Strapi URL and a Full-access API token.

say_en.text: Why is there no CMS data in the seo-analysis report?
say_en.note: Claude will start the CMS setup flow.
